check: the exact report schema the closing step must read, and a correction to my own earlier statement

finalReportSchema.file: stress-report.json, written by StressFixture.writeReport only when the profile ends
finalReportSchema.verdictFields: passed and durationMet, which is exactly what the ledger's rule requires

otherFilesHaveDifferentSchemas.header: written at start: coldCache, concurrency, cpu, durationSeconds, farSegments, gpu, jdk, jvmFlags, modSHA, mode, mods, os, purpose, ramJvmMaxHeapBytes, seed, worldSeed
otherFilesHaveDifferentSchemas.samples: written periodically: afterGcExplicit, afterGcHeapBytes, completedChunks, counters, elapsedSeconds, gauges, openFiles, threads, timings, usedHeapBytes
otherFilesHaveDifferentSchemas.consequence: Neither header nor sample carries passed or durationMet. A reader who greps a sample for the verdict finds nothing and might conclude the field is missing rather than that it belongs to a different file.

correctionOfMyOwnStatement: Earlier this round I said there was no run-* directory. That was wrong: the directory exists at run-1791334079847 and holds 509 samples plus header.json, about 2 MB. The path had printed correctly on the line above my claim, so the error was in the narration rather than the check.

progressAtThisReading.note: Absent by design: the report is written once at the end.
